notes.title: Patch notes 1.21
notes.notes:
- Fixed that enemies do not detect flashlight light on EASY difficulty level.
- Fixed some Italian text.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.18
notes.notes:
- Some corrections to German text.
- Some corrections to Indonesian text.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.13
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue where enemy hair was not displayed when looking at the enemy through some glass.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.12
notes.notes:
- Added ruby to some Japanese text.
- Corrected some Korean text.

notes.title: Patch notes 1.11
notes.notes:
- Korean language is now supported.
- Fixed a bug in which the 10 yen game could be checked when being attacked by special enemies.
- The distance at which the sound of a door opening and closing is noticed by the target has been shortened.
- Shortened the time from when a target is detected to when its tracking accuracy begins to drop.
- Increased the maximum amount of error in enemy tracking accuracy.
- Adjusted the distance from which enemy footsteps and voices can be heard.
- Other minor adjustments have been made to enemy AI.

Special Thanks
Korean translation by DAEHYEOK

notes.title: Patch notes 1.10
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that could trap enemies in certain rooms.
- Changed the interact icons of certain objects.
- Adjusted the action probability of enemies in NORMAL difficulty level.

notes.title: Patch note 1.09
notes.notes:
- The activation interval of the boss's special attack was changed from common for all difficulty levels to each difficulty level.
- Shortened the activation interval of the boss's special attack.

notes.title: Patch note 1.08
notes.notes: - Adjusted the encounter rate with enemies below NORMAL difficulty level.

notes.title: Patch note 1.07
notes.notes: - Changed the location of some items because they were difficult to find.

notes.title: Patch note 1.05
notes.notes:
- Extended direction of movement for running.
- Adjustment of enemy AI.

notes.title: Patch note 1.03
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented some of the enemy AI mitigation processes based on difficulty from functioning properly.

notes.title: Patch note 1.02
notes.notes: Fixed mistranslation of some texts in Simplified Chinese.

notes.title: Release Date Set for December 7th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44304401/9c39ab163ea5bd6bce2f97e0b4fe251dbd7c3b5c.png
We are excited to announce that the release date for "Hollow Cocoon" has been set for December 7, 2023.

Development is currently in its final stages, and we appreciate your patience as we prepare for the release.

Furthermore, we are currently offering a demo version of the game.
Items acquired in the demo, such as 'Winning Tickets,' can be carried over to the full version of the game. 
(If you have saved data from the demo, the transfer will occur automatically upon launching the full version.)
If you're interested in the game, we encourage you to try out the demo.




https://store.steampowered.com/app/2414630/
